name: orchestration
description: Main-session orchestrator agent: plans work, routes it to the installed agents and verifies the results. Ships the claude-orchestrate launcher (linked into ~/.local/bin at session start), which appends the orchestration prompt to Claude Code's default system prompt and can start Claude inside herdr.

linkLauncher.title: Link the claude-orchestrate launcher
linkLauncher.description: Off: the SessionStart hook leaves ~/.local/bin/claude-orchestrate alone. An existing link keeps pointing at the install it was made from. Only an exact false turns it off.
